notes: Self-declared Battle Royale and Zero Build, so Shooter leads with the Battle Royale preset, but unlike a plain match request this build is a lobby plus a match map, so I swapped the preset's open-battlefield for space-staged - the only shape that says waiting players cannot see into or clip into the match area. Party & Casual is named second because it owns the two rows this needs and Shooter has neither: its social-hub is the lobby sized for the whole server, and its teleporter-link is the lobby-to-stage transport, which is where the battle bus departure lives. P4 is earned rather than assumed: a compact readable plaza and a full battle royale island cannot share one surface, and the answers already spent their simplification by making both modes share a single match map, since Zero Build only disables construction. Dropped the preset's building-interior because nothing in the prompt goes indoors and I would be buying an unrequested P3, while the RFV-bucks shop, the 800-point battle pass and the four Robux purchase options are UI and economy rather than geometry, and keeping players' original skins means there is no dress-up or customization space to build.
